title: microsorum normale
intro: Microsorum normale, commonly known as Java Fern, is a species of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its air-purifying properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Java Fern include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Microsorum normale include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
